title: PromptLayer-inspired daily theme package
summary: Project iteration record for adding a production-safe PromptLayer-inspired visual theme layer to generated public daily report pages. The implementation keeps the existing effective-interact pre-rendered renderer, injects a scoped self-contained theme marker and CSS block during site build, and avoids copying third-party assets or relying on remote runtime styles.

lessons.lesson: Inspired visual systems should be implemented as owned theme tokens and behavior, not as copied product assets.
lessons.evidence: The new theme module provides scoped CSS tokens, layout treatment, motion, and responsive rules while unit tests reject PromptLayer-origin asset URLs and remote stylesheet dependencies.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future external-style references at the level of visual principles and encode them as repository-owned theme modules with explicit asset-source tests.

lessons.lesson: Theme work must remain downstream of the production renderer contract.
lessons.evidence: The built report keeps the effective-interact generator metadata, pre-rendered mode, grouped navigation, filterable cards, and tracking components while adding only a post-generation theme layer.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding additional visual themes, inject them through the same site-build override layer unless the renderer contract itself needs a tested change.

suggestions.issue: A direct clone of PromptLayer assets would be brittle, legally risky, and incompatible with the public daily renderer contract.
suggestions.evidence: Implementation adds `src/daily-theme.js`, applies it from `src/site.js`, and verifies generated report HTML has one scoped theme block with no remote stylesheet/script dependencies or PromptLayer static asset URLs.
suggestions.suggestion: Treat external visual references as an inspiration brief, then ship a self-contained theme package with deterministic injection, reduced-motion support, responsive checks, and renderer-contract assertions.
suggestions.expected_benefit: The daily report gains a reusable high-contrast editorial visual system without creating a dependency on PromptLayer upstream resources or replacing the tested report generator.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented in the daily site build theme layer, covered by unit tests, E2E assertions, generated HTML inspection, and desktop/mobile browser screenshots.
validation_evidence: promptlayer-inspired daily theme is injected into production report html
promptlayer-inspired daily theme injector is idempotent and self-contained

followups.action: Extend the theme package to the index page only after defining index-specific acceptance checks for archive navigation and feed scanning.
